name: The Casino
description: Gambling House, the entertainment center of Datang Street, has various chess and card games to entertain guests. Its shape is flamboyant, and its eaves are as deep as a bird spreading its wings; its colors are bright and eye-catching, bright red and purple, and it is full of joy; small dice are hung throughout the building, symbolizing rolling wealth. During festivals, this place is particularly lively. Many people want to take advantage of the festive atmosphere and go to the gambling house to make money and make a lot of money.
